column3: Share UI on #24: Share, Stop sharing, a copyable link and a Shared row badge; no expiry; mutating Drive ops keep one command id per op only while the args are unchanged and no ack came back
column4: #24's drive.share takes { scope, path } only, so expiry would be speculative. Any ack retires the id, because the host replays an acked id: reusing it after a share, unshare, share would return the first share's stale result, and a retried bad_args would replay the rejection even after the person fixed the cause
